title: NESRA FloodWatch — Rasuwa / Bhotekoshi situation brief
body: Independent geospatial / satellite situational awareness page for the Rasuwa–Bhotekoshi–Trishuli flood. Not a government filing system and not a missing-persons registry. NESRA says follow DHM, NDRRMA and local authorities for official warnings. Useful for access, impact, and Earth-observation context.
